name: souzoku-mendan
description: 相続税申告 AIリアルタイム面談・必要資料管理システム

scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w relay && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w relay && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-souzoku-mendan --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit=./.emulator-data
scripts.emulators:clean: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-souzoku-mendan
